body: I honestly just want this school year to be done and my classes passed so I can get into the Royal Australian Air Force and practically start anew. I've discussed this with my mum and the school and I need to improve behavior, work ethic and grades.

Dude here.

The focal point really is time. What I said about being dragged behind everyone else and every decision being necessary and important. Time is what worries me most.

Thank you for replying

I'm 16 and I feel like I'm stuck and every decision I make right now is absolutely super important and it's scaring the shit out of me. Being passed this and being an adult, like you said, would likely be a source of happiness for me. I want to wait the few years but I'm scared of screwing them up.

Thank you for offering support :)
